A Ministry of Education report dated 2 June 2023 describes a five-day workshop by NCERT’s Regional Institute of Education, Bhubaneswar, and the Central University of Odisha. Participants prepared two primary alphabet books across Kui and Desia.

They selected words with illustrations, arranged lessons around vowels and consonants, and included Odia letters. Trials with local speakers, revision and another workshop were still planned. The report records preparation, not completed classroom adoption.
Ministry of Education · Kui and Desia workshop (2023)
PIB release, 2 June 2023: workshop summary. Preparation, proposed local trials and revision are distinct stages.
Keep publication stages clear
The June 2023 workshop report described preparation and future testing. Confirm a book’s edition and availability before planning to use it.
Read the dated education workshop account
Choosing words is only the beginning of a first book. A documented workshop shows the distance between preparation and classroom use.
From selected words to a tested book
